reportedProblem: Gas calculation appeared unresponsive before wallet connection; small typography and complex layout were also reported.
diagnosis: The cost button previously required writable state, which required a connected wallet, despite the public read-only address flow.
The prior quoted() test fixture always connected a wallet before estimating and did not cover that public cost-check path.
Default captureAndAnalyze previously lacked a readiness preflight and readable InvalidObservation or DuplicateReport decoding.
coverage: A selected registered address enables the cost button with no browser wallet; a public cost preview shows an exact positive estimate and reserve using a fixed nonowner simulation sender.
Public previews have no owner and cannot satisfy the wallet quote matcher, enable consent/send, write a transaction journal or request wallet access.
Connecting after a preview recomputes gas and fees from the actual wallet account and clears consent; failure to obtain the wallet quote leaves no preview or approval behind.
Actual minSpacing and snapshot preflight reject a sample that is too recent or whose source code changed, before gas estimation.
Sampling, reader and RPC failures clear an earlier cost preview and present actionable visible feedback without requesting a wallet or funds.
Nested ABI custom InvalidObservation(7) and DuplicateReport error data produce readable sampling or fresh-report guidance.
Wallet account or chain events during an in-flight public estimate prevent the stale response from installing a quote.
All prior70 frontend tests remain passing, including16 Intel identity/pin/quote/budget/recovery/security cases and6 address lookup cases.
environment: Node built-in test runner; minimal DOM and injected RPC/wallet mocks; real bundled ethers ABI encoding, tuple decoding and hashing
limits: This report covers interaction and security semantics. It is not a comprehensive accessibility, contrast, font-size or visual layout audit; root-owned browser QA verifies those changes separately.
These mocks do not constitute browser-extension or funded-wallet QA.
No public RPC request, mainnet deployment or signed transaction was performed by this suite.
Historical validation reports were left unchanged.
finalMarkupRefinement: Removed repeated tutorial steps, moved other actions into Technical details, and placed wallet connection after the fee result; all73 tests rerun and passing.
